ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food chain with a leaf on the left, a caterpillar in the middle, and a chameleon on the right. There is an arrow from Leaf to Caterpillar, and another arrow from Caterpillar to Chameleon. Reasoning: In a food chain, an arrow from one organism to another means the second organism gets food or energy from the first. The arrow from the leaf to the caterpillar shows that caterpillars depend on leaves for food. If all the leaves died, the caterpillars would lose their food source, so the caterpillar population would decrease.
